text:
Eli Harper: quick review request for the compact rollout row -- major points: rollforward wording, short variant labels for PMs, and SR announces for timeline scrubber. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/compact-rollout
Noor Ahmed: looks tidy. label nit: use human-visible short labels like 'Canary A' + hidden full slug. avoid long model ids in the pill.
Samir Gupta: agree. for keyboard users, tooltip content must be accessible via Enter (expand inline) not hover-only.
Eli Harper: good call. inline expansion on Enter; hover shows brief hint only.
AssistBot: accessibility check: recommend aria-live="polite" with short phrases. examples:
"Timeline: Apr 02, 2026  staged 10% to Canary A (canary)"
"Timeline: Apr 01, 2026  rolled back to v2.2 (reverted)"
Noor Ahmed: copy question: action menu uses 'Rollback' / 'Roll forward'. modal should be explicit: title 'Confirm roll forward' body 'Make v3.0 live for all traffic? Audit note (optional):' primary 'Roll forward' secondary 'Cancel'.
Samir Gupta: modal accessibility: set role="alertdialog", focus primary button on open, include aria-label that repeats the action and version. add optional reason field stored in history metadata.
Eli Harper: UX: show ephemeral banner after action: 'Rolled forward to v3.0 — Undo' with 25s timer. Undo must be keyboard reachable and announced.
AssistBot: visual check: active pill contrast meets 4.5:1; variant color palette passes 3:1 for labels. recommend adding letter prefixes (A/B) visible in compact mode to help colorblind users.
Noor Ahmed: percent slider note: backend supports whole integers only. UI should enforce integer step and helper text: 'Traffic allocation accepts whole percentages only.'
Samir Gupta: SR delta announcement when allocation changes: 'Allocation changed: Canary A +5%'. keep it short.
PreviewBot: preview deployed for branch 'compact-rollup' at sha 123def  https://preview.redwood.dev/compact-rollup
Eli Harper: thanks all, I'll update Figma and tag for final signoff.
